notes: Game casting upgrades (the display side): the streamed game now fills and resizes with the window, a new Sharp/Smooth upscaler toggle in the Streaming bar, and casts now carry AUDIO — played on the display device with a sound on/off button. No more digging into Settings: when a device starts casting on your Wi-Fi, this app pops up an 'A game is casting — Display it?' prompt, and there's a 'Find devices' scanner if you'd rather pick it manually. (Audio from a phone needs the phone's app updated to this version too.)
